raw.description:
About us

LifeMD is a leading provider of virtual primary care, telehealth, and specialized treatment programs serving hundreds of thousands of patients nationwide. Our vertically integrated platform combines 50-state licensed providers, in-house pharmacy and lab integrations, and proprietary technology that enables safe, high-quality, and affordable care.

At the heart of this transformation is our team of developers, engineers, and tech innovators building state-of-the-art systems that make healthcare smarter, faster, and more accessible. From architecting scalable backend systems to crafting intuitive user experiences, we are pushing boundaries every day.

Recognized as one of the fastest-growing healthcare tech companies (#166 on Deloitte Fast 500 in 2023), LifeMD is not just a healthcare company â it's a tech company revolutionizing healthcare.

About the role

LifeMD is seeking a strategic, data-obsessed Director of Customer Experience to lead and elevate our remote customer operations. This role sits at the intersection of technology, clinical empathy, and operational excellence. We are looking for someone who has built and continuously evolved high-performing, technology-enabled CX organizations; deploying AI voice and chat tools, engineering data-driven performance cultures, and creating differentiated, concierge-level experiences that drive loyalty and growth.

Reporting directly to the SVP of Operations & Patient Experience, you will translate the executive team's vision and strategy into operational reality,surfacing the voice of the customer, driving measurable performance, and partnering cross-functionally to embed customer insights into decisions across the organization. If you thrive in fast-moving health tech environments and believe exceptional customer experience is a commercial advantage, we want to hear from you.

Responsibilities

Remote Contact Center Leadership

  • Lead, scale, and continuously optimize a remote contact center team across multiple channels (voice, chat, email, SMS). Setting KPIs, driving performance expectations, and driving continuous improvement.
  • Set and enforce service level standards, workforce management practices, scheduling, capacity models, and escalation protocols
  • Build a high-accountability, coaching-first culture across team leads and frontline agents

Customer Experience

  • Develop and maintain service blueprints and experience standards across contact and service touchpoints that transform support from a transactional function into a driver of loyalty and advocacy
  • Champion a culture of empathy, accountability, and customer-centricity across the entire CX organization

AI & Technology Integration

  • Own the performance of AI-powered support functions including AI voice (conversational IVR), chatbots, and agent-assist tools â monitoring deflection rates, containment quality, sentiment signals, and escalation patterns
  • Partner with Product and Engineering to evaluate, implement, and iterate on AI tooling that augments agent performance and improves resolution rates without sacrificing human connection
  • Ensure deep integration between CX technology and broader customer-facing platforms including EHR, CRM, and marketing automation systems
  • â¢ Stay current on emerging customer support technologies and serve as the internal subject matter expert on responsible AI use within a healthcare context

Data-Driven Performance Management

  • Define, track, and improve core CX metrics: first contact resolution, average handle time, CSAT, NPS, escalation rate, AI containment rate, retention, and reactivation
  • Monitor NPS trends surfaced through the CX function and partner with the Manager of Patient Experience to close the loop on customer feedback and drive operational improvements
  • Build and maintain dashboards and reporting cadences that provide real-time operational visibility to your team and to the SVP
  • Conduct root cause analysis on performance gaps and translate findings into structured improvement plans
  • Synthesize customer insights, VOC data, and operational trends into clear, executive-ready briefings

Commercial Impact & Customer Lifecycle

  • Align CX operations with revenue and retention goals, connecting CSAT, NPS, and resolution metrics to commercial outcomes including retention, upsell conversion, and reactivation
  • Identify patterns in customer friction that represent risk to renewal, referral, or acquisition, and advocate for fixes cross-functionally
  • Support onboarding and activation workflows that reduce time-to-value; contribute to behavioral engagement and churn prediction strategies

Quality Assurance

  • Design and maintain a rigorous QA framework covering interaction quality, compliance, empathy standards, and clinical accuracy
  • Establish calibration processes across QA reviewers to ensure scoring consistency and fairness
  • Use QA insights to inform targeted coaching, training curricula, and process improvement

Budget Management

  • Manage the CX department budget within parameters, including headcount planning, vendor contracts, and technology spend
  • Identify cost optimization opportunities without compromising service quality or customer outcomes; present trade-off analyses and recommendations

Remote Transition & Operational Build-Out

  • Lead the operational transition to a fully remote customer service model, owning the end-to-end migration across people, process, technology, and compliance workstreams
  • Partner with HR, IT, Legal, and Operations to execute the transition with minimal disruption to the customer experience, establishing remote workforce policies and tooling standards
  • Use the transition as an opportunity to redesign foundational processes and eliminate legacy inefficiencies

Team Leadership & Development

  • Recruit, develop, and retain a high-performing team of managers, team leads, QA specialists, trainers, and agents
  • Build workforce planning, career pathing, and succession pipelines within the CX organization
  • Design the management rhythms, coaching frameworks, and recognition programs that attract and retain top talent in a fully remote environment

Cross-Functional Partnership & Internal Alignment

  • Serve as a key operational partner to the Manager of Patient Experience, ensuring alignment between customer-facing service operations and the broader patient experience program
  • Collaborate closely with the Manager of Patient Experience to align on messaging touchpoints, technology integrations, and shared data â recognizing that the customer journey spans both functions and requires active coordination to deliver a coherent experience
  • Support the SVP of Operations & Patient Experience in executing the overall CX vision, roadmap, and resource planning
  • Collaborate with Product, Clinical, Marketing, Sales, and Finance to embed the customer perspective in upstream decisions
  • Prepare structured insights, trend analyses, and investment recommendations for the SVP to carry into executive forums

Requirements

  • 7+ years of progressive CX, contact center, or customer operations leadership experience, with direct people management responsibility
  • Demonstrated experience leading remote or distributed teams of 50 or more across multiple channels and functions
  • Hands-on experience implementing or managing AI/automation in a customer service context (chatbots, conversational IVR, agent-assist tools)
  • Strong analytical skills â comfortable building dashboards, interpreting performance data, and translating insights into operational action
  • Proven track record connecting CX performance to commercial outcomes including retention, reactivation, and revenue
  • Experience managing vendor relationships including BPO partners and technology providers
  • Experience building or maturing QA programs in a regulated or compliance-sensitive environment
  • Demonstrated ability to manage a department budget, including headcount, vendor, and technology spend

Preferred

  • Background in health tech, digital health, telehealth, or healthcare services
  • Familiarity with HIPAA requirements as they apply to CX operations, technology platforms, and data handling
  • Experience with platforms such as Salesforce Service Cloud, Zendesk, Five9, Genesys, or similar CRM/WFM tools
  • Exposure to customer and patient experience frameworks (e.g., service blueprinting, NPS program design, churn prediction models)
  • Background in a direct-to-consumer or subscription-based business where CX plays a direct role in lifetime value

Building the Future of Crypto 

Our Krakenites are a world-class team with crypto conviction, united by our desire to discover and unlock the potential of crypto and blockchain technology.

What makes us different?

Kraken is a mission-focused company rooted in crypto values. As a Krakenite, you’ll join us on our mission to accelerate the global adoption of crypto, so that everyone can achieve financial freedom and inclusion. For over a decade, Kraken’s focus on our mission and crypto ethos has attracted many of the most talented crypto experts in the world.

Before you apply, please read the Kraken Culture page to learn more about our internal culture, values, and mission. We also expect candidates to familiarize themselves with the Kraken app. Learn how to create a Kraken account here.

As a fully remote company, we have Krakenites in 70+ countries who speak over 50 languages. Krakenites are industry pioneers who develop premium crypto products for experienced traders, institutions, and newcomers to the space. Kraken is committed to industry-leading security, crypto education, and world-class client support through our products like Kraken Pro, Desktop, Wallet, and Kraken Futures.

Become a Krakenite and build the future of crypto!

Proof of work

The team

We are seeking a skilled & hands-on Senior Security Architect for Kraken Security Labs. Kraken Security Labs provides boutique-style, deeply technical internal security consulting on current and future products.

We don't merely provide high-level guidance but indeed get deeply embedded in the different engineering teams and do not mind hands-on work.

Our projects span from classical infrastructure security projects, over cryptography, web3, and complex Rust projects, to securing our next generation of AI products.

You will work in a small, highly technical team and collaborate with teams all across the company & world.

The opportunity

  • Design, review & verify robust security architecture in a heterogeneous environment

  • Conduct thorough security assessments and audits of existing architectures, recommending practical improvements

  • Stay updated with latest (blockchain) security trends, threats and mitigation techniques

  • Provide expertise to our blockchain teams, ensuring secure operational practices

Skills you should HODL

  • Proven experience as an IT security expert, with a strong background in application security

  • Experience in security testing diverse application

  • Experience with infrastructure security

  • Basic familiarity with security frameworks (OWASP, NIST, etc)

  • Excellent problem-solving skills and the ability to work in a dynamic, fast-paced environment

  • Strong communication and collaboration skills to effectively remotely work with stakeholders across the organization

Unless a specific application deadline is stated in the job posting, applications are accepted on an ongoing basis.

Please note, applicants are permitted to redact or remove information on their resume that identifies age, date of birth, or dates of attendance at or graduation from an educational institution.

We consider qualified applicants with criminal histories for employment on our team, assessing candidates in a manner consistent with the requirements of the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance.

Kraken is powered by people from around the world and we celebrate all Krakenites for their diverse talents, backgrounds, contributions and unique perspectives. We hire strictly based on merit, meaning we seek out the candidates with the right abilities, knowledge, and skills considered the most suitable for the job. We encourage you to apply for roles where you don't fully meet the listed requirements, especially if you're passionate or knowledgable about crypto!

We may ask candidates to complete job-related skills or work-style assessments as part of our hiring process. These assessments are designed to evaluate competencies relevant to the role and are applied consistently across candidates for similar positions. Assessment results are considered alongside other relevant information, such as experience and interviews, and are not the sole basis for any employment decision.

As an equal opportunity employer, we don’t tolerate discrimination or harassment of any kind. Whether that’s based on race, ethnicity, age, gender identity, citizenship, religion, sexual orientation, disability, pregnancy, veteran status or any other protected characteristic as outlined by federal, state or local laws.

title: Principal Engineer - Catalog
description: Job Summary: The Principal Engineer - Catalog operates at the intersection of deep technical execution and broad organizational influence. This role will resolve the hardest architectural questions, set the AI-native engineering bar, and ensure that iHerb's platform decisions compound over time rather than accumulate debt. Reporting to the VP of Engineering this role collaborates closely with peer Principals, Engineering Managers, and peer VPs across the organization. The Principal Engineer - Catalog owns the end-to-end technical strategy for iHerb's product catalog platform, one of the most business-critical systems in the company. This role will lead the catalog modernization effort, define service boundaries and data models, and set the full-stack engineering bar for the Catalog team. Job Expectations: Define and own the catalog platform architecture: service design, data modeling, API contracts, and technology choices across the stack. Lead the technical scoping and execution of the catalog modernization effort, coordinating with the Catalog EM and cross-functional partners. Hands-on contributor: write production code, build proofs of concept, and validate architecture through working software. Set and enforce technical standards for the Catalog team; drive code reviews and architecture reviews. Identify and resolve cross-cutting technical dependencies with peer engineering teams and shared platform services. Contribute catalog-specific patterns and lessons into iHerb's shared AI-driven SDLC golden path. Drive the hardest cross-cutting technical decisions across multiple teams and shared platform services. Establish and evolve iHerb's AI-driven SDLC golden path: shared standards, Claude Code skills, guardrails, and automation patterns. Lead complex multi-team technical efforts by coordinating architecture reviews, aligning peer Principals and EMs, and resolving competing approaches. Mentor and raise the technical bar across the engineering organization through code review, architecture review, and direct coaching of senior engineers. Represent engineering in cross-functional conversations with product, data science, security, and infrastructure. Feed architectural decisions into the shared knowledge base so institutional knowledge compounds across the organization. The duties and responsibilities described above may provide only a partial description of this position. This is not an exhaustive list of all aspects of the job. Other duties and responsibilities not outlined in this document may be added as necessary or desirable, with or without notice. Knowledge, Skills and Abilities: Required: AI-driven SDLC (required): demonstrated use of AI-assisted development tools such as Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, or Cursor to ship production systems. Can articulate workflow changes, quality tradeoffs, and guardrail strategies. Architecture at scale: experience designing and evolving large-scale distributed systems across multiple teams and years: APIs, data pipelines, event-driven architectures, or high-traffic platforms. Cross-org technical leadership: track record of driving architectural standards, technical roadmaps, or platform initiatives that span multiple teams or organizations. Engineering quality mindset: deeply held opinions on code quality, observability, CI/CD, test automation, and maintaining velocity without accumulating hidden debt. Communication and influence: able to write clear architecture documents, present to technical and non-technical audiences, and build consensus without formal authority. Experience working in distributed teams across the US, China, and Latin America. Deep backend engineering experience with at least one of: C#/.NET (strongly preferred), Go, Java, or Python, at production scale. Proven experience designing data models and APIs for high-volume catalog, inventory, or e-commerce systems. Full-stack capability: able to contribute meaningfully to frontend (React or equivalent) and own backend-to-UI architectural decisions. Experience driving a large-scale platform modernization or rewrite effort, including migration strategy and risk management. High degree of accuracy and attention to detail Excellent organization skills and ability to multi-task Equipment Knowledge: Experience with Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, PowerPoint) Experience with Google Business Suite (Gmail, Drive, Docs, Sheets, Forms) preferred Experience Requirements: Generally requires a minimum of 10+ years of software engineering experience, with a significant portion at senior, staff, or principal IC level. Education Requirements: Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science or related field preferred, or a combination of education and equivalent work experience. Judgment/Reasoning Ability: Able to identify, troubleshoot and resolve problems quickly using sound judgment, poise and diplomacy. Ability to use judgment and reasoning skills, and determine when to escalate issues, as required, in a timely manner. Physical Demands: The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by a Team Member to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. While performing the duties of this job, the Team Member is regularly required to talk and hear. The Team Member is frequently required to sit, walk, climb stairs, use hands and fingers, bend, stoop and reach with hands and arms. Reaching above shoulder heights, below the waist or lifting as required to file documents or store materials throughout the work day. The Team Member may occasionally lift or move office products and supplies up to 25 pounds. Proper lifting techniques required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. Work Environment: The noise in the work environment is usually moderate. Job Summary: 

The Principal Engineer - Mobile operates at the intersection of deep technical execution and broad organizational influence. This role will resolve the hardest architectural questions, set the AI-native engineering bar, and ensure that iHerb's platform decisions compound over time rather than accumulate debt. Reporting to the VP of Engineering this role collaborates closely with peer Principals, Engineering Managers, and peer VPs across the organization. 

This role owns the end-to-end technical strategy for iHerb's mobile platform, covering iOS and Android apps used by millions of customers globally. You will lead the mobile modernization effort, drive platform and architecture decisions, and set the technical bar for the Mobile team. 

Job Expectations:

  • Define and own the mobile platform architecture: platform choices, app structure, shared component strategy, and native versus cross-platform patterns. 

  • Lead the technical scoping and execution of the mobile modernization effort, coordinating with the Mobile EM and cross-functional partners. 

  • Hands-on contributor: write production mobile code, build proofs of concept, and validate architecture through working software. 

  • Set and enforce technical standards for the Mobile team; drive code reviews and architecture reviews.

  • Evaluate and decide on cross-platform frameworks where appropriate, based on engineering tradeoffs and long-term maintainability. 

  • Contribute mobile-specific patterns and lessons into iHerb's shared AI-driven SDLC golden path. 

  • Drive the hardest cross-cutting technical decisions across multiple teams and shared platform services. 

  • Establish and evolve iHerb's AI-driven SDLC golden path: shared standards, Claude Code skills, guardrails, and automation patterns. 

  • Lead complex multi-team technical efforts by coordinating architecture reviews, aligning peer Principals and EMs, and resolving competing approaches. 

  • Mentor and raise the technical bar across the engineering organization through code review, architecture review, and direct coaching of senior engineers. 

  • Represent engineering in cross-functional conversations with product, data science, security, and infrastructure. 

  • Feed architectural decisions into the shared knowledge base so institutional knowledge compounds across the organization. 

The duties and responsibilities described above may provide only a partial description of this position. This is not an exhaustive list of all aspects of the job. Other duties and responsibilities not outlined in this document may be added as necessary or desirable, with or without notice.

Knowledge, Skills and Abilities:

Required:

  • AI-driven SDLC (required): demonstrated use of AI-assisted development tools such as Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, or Cursor to ship production systems. Can articulate workflow changes, quality tradeoffs, and guardrail strategies. 

  • Architecture at scale: experience designing and evolving large-scale distributed systems across multiple teams and years: APIs, data pipelines, event-driven architectures, or high-traffic platforms.

  • Cross-org technical leadership: track record of driving architectural standards, technical roadmaps, or platform initiatives that span multiple teams or organizations.

  • Engineering quality mindset: deeply held opinions on code quality, observability, CI/CD, test automation, and maintaining velocity without accumulating hidden debt. 

  • Communication and influence: able to write clear architecture documents, present to technical and non-technical audiences, and build consensus without formal authority. 

  • Experience working in distributed teams across the US, China, and Latin America.

  • Deep expertise in Swift (iOS) and Kotlin (Android); production-level experience in both platforms is required at this level. 

  • Hands-on experience with cross-platform mobile frameworks: React Native or Kotlin Multiplatform.

  • Track record of owning mobile platform architecture decisions: app structure, state management, offline handling, performance, and release processes. 

  • Experience leading a mobile platform modernization or significant re-architecture effort. 

  • High degree of accuracy and attention to detail

  • Excellent organization skills and ability to multi-task

Equipment Knowledge:

  • Experience with Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, PowerPoint)

  • Experience with Google Business Suite (Gmail, Drive, Docs, Sheets, Forms) preferred

Experience Requirements:

Generally requires a minimum of 10+ years of software engineering experience, with a significant portion at senior, staff, or principal IC level.

Education Requirements: 

Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science or related field preferred, or a combination of education and equivalent work experience.

Judgment/Reasoning Ability: Able to identify, troubleshoot and resolve problems quickly using sound judgment, poise and diplomacy. Ability to use judgment and reasoning skills, and determine when to escalate issues, as required, in a timely manner.

Physical Demands: The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by a Team Member to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. While performing the duties of this job, the Team Member is regularly required to talk and hear. The Team Member is frequently required to sit, walk, climb stairs, use hands and fingers, bend, stoop and reach with hands and arms. Reaching above shoulder heights, below the waist or lifting as required to file documents or store materials throughout the work day. The Team Member may occasionally lift or move office products and supplies up to 25 pounds. Proper lifting techniques required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

Work Environment: The noise in the work environment is usually moderate. Other factors are:

  • Hectic, fast-paced with multi-level distractions

  • Professional, yet casual work environment

  • Office / Warehouse environment

  • Ability to work extended hours as required

raw.jobDescription:
Job Summary: 

The Principal Engineer operates at the intersection of deep technical execution and broad organizational influence. This role will resolve the hardest architectural questions, set the AI-native engineering bar, and ensure that iHerb's platform decisions compound over time rather than accumulate debt. Reporting to the VP of Engineering this role collaborates closely with peer Principals, Engineering Managers, and peer VPs across the organization. 

This role owns the end-to-end technical strategy for iHerb's AI Platform and GenAI product experiences. This spans the user-facing AI layer (Wellness Agent, LLM-driven recommendations, RAG over catalog and reviews, generative content) and the shared AI infrastructure (RAG pipelines, evals framework, MLOps, guardrails, observability) that makes AI features production-grade and repeatable across the engineering organization. 

Job Expectations:

  • Define and own the AI platform architecture: retrieval infrastructure, model lifecycle, evals framework, guardrails, and GenAI product feature design.

  • Lead the build of the shared AI platform layer consumed by all AI product features and reusable by internal business teams. 

  • Hands-on contributor: build production AI systems, write proofs of concept, and validate architecture through working software. 

  • Set and enforce technical standards for the AI Platform team; drive architecture reviews and model quality reviews. 

  • Coordinate with the Personalization team to define clear boundaries between the GenAI product layer and existing ML personalization infrastructure. 

  • Contribute AI platform-specific patterns and lessons into iHerb's shared AI-driven SDLC golden path. 

  • Drive the hardest cross-cutting technical decisions across multiple teams and shared platform services. 

  • Establish and evolve iHerb's AI-driven SDLC golden path: shared standards, Claude Code skills, guardrails, and automation patterns. 

  • Lead complex multi-team technical efforts by coordinating architecture reviews, aligning peer Principals and EMs, and resolving competing approaches. 

  • Mentor and raise the technical bar across the engineering organization through code review, architecture review, and direct coaching of senior engineers. 

  • Represent engineering in cross-functional conversations with product, data science, security, and infrastructure. 

  • Feed architectural decisions into the shared knowledge base so institutional knowledge compounds across the organization. 

The duties and responsibilities described above may provide only a partial description of this position. This is not an exhaustive list of all aspects of the job. Other duties and responsibilities not outlined in this document may be added as necessary or desirable, with or without notice.

Knowledge, Skills and Abilities:

Required:

  • AI-driven SDLC (required): demonstrated use of AI-assisted development tools such as Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, or Cursor to ship production systems. Can articulate workflow changes, quality tradeoffs, and guardrail strategies. 

  • Architecture at scale: experience designing and evolving large-scale distributed systems across multiple teams and years: APIs, data pipelines, event-driven architectures, or high-traffic platforms.

  • Cross-org technical leadership: track record of driving architectural standards, technical roadmaps, or platform initiatives that span multiple teams or organizations.

  • Engineering quality mindset: deeply held opinions on code quality, observability, CI/CD, test automation, and maintaining velocity without accumulating hidden debt. 

  • Communication and influence: able to write clear architecture documents, present to technical and non-technical audiences, and build consensus without formal authority. 

  • Experience working in distributed teams across the US, China, and Latin America.

  • Production experience designing and operating AI platform systems: RAG pipelines, vector search, embedding infrastructure, or retrieval-augmented applications at scale. 

  • Hands-on experience with LLM evaluation: building eval frameworks, defining quality metrics, and iterating on model and prompt quality using data. 

  • MLOps experience: model deployment, monitoring, lifecycle management, and cost governance in a production environment. 

  • Experience building and operating agentic systems using frameworks such as LangChain, LlamaIndex, or equivalent. 

  • GenAI in production is required; prototype or research-only experience is not sufficient at this level. 

  • High degree of accuracy and attention to detail

  • Excellent organization skills and ability to multi-task

Equipment Knowledge:

  • Experience with Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, PowerPoint)

  • Experience with Google Business Suite (Gmail, Drive, Docs, Sheets, Forms) preferred

Experience Requirements:

Generally requires a minimum of 10+ years of software engineering experience, with a significant portion at senior, staff, or principal IC level.

Education Requirements: 

Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science or related field preferred, or a combination of education and equivalent work experience.

Judgment/Reasoning Ability: Able to identify, troubleshoot and resolve problems quickly using sound judgment, poise and diplomacy. Ability to use judgment and reasoning skills, and determine when to escalate issues, as required, in a timely manner.

Physical Demands: The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by a Team Member to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. While performing the duties of this job, the Team Member is regularly required to talk and hear. The Team Member is frequently required to sit, walk, climb stairs, use hands and fingers, bend, stoop and reach with hands and arms. Reaching above shoulder heights, below the waist or lifting as required to file documents or store materials throughout the work day. The Team Member may occasionally lift or move office products and supplies up to 25 pounds. Proper lifting techniques required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

Work Environment: The noise in the work environment is usually moderate. Other factors are:

  • Hectic, fast-paced with multi-level distractions

  • Professional, yet casual work environment

  • Office / Warehouse environment

  • Ability to work extended hours as required

About The Opportunity

LMG Staffing Solutions is partnering with a collaborative, design-driven digital agency to identify a Creative Director for a contract opportunity based in Philadelphia.

This role brings together brand strategy, creative leadership, and digital expertise to help clients solve complex business challenges through compelling, human-centered experiences. You will lead the strategic and creative vision across a diverse portfolio that may include healthcare, higher education, enterprise organizations, and emerging brands.

The ideal candidate can guide engagements from discovery through execution, lead multidisciplinary teams, strengthen creative quality, and connect creative recommendations to measurable business outcomes.

What You'll Do

Strategic Brand Leadership

  • Lead the development of brand strategies, positioning, messaging frameworks, and digital experience recommendations
  • Connect strategic and creative recommendations to client goals, audience insights, and business objectives
  • Facilitate discovery sessions, stakeholder workshops, and strategic planning engagements
  • Translate research and business insights into compelling brand narratives, messaging platforms, and customer experience strategies
  • Identify opportunities across marketing, digital experiences, products, and services
  • Partner with client services teams to align recommendations with client priorities, budgets, and long-term goals

Creative Leadership

  • Establish the strategic and creative vision for client engagements
  • Develop creative briefs with clear direction, measurable objectives, and actionable guidance
  • Lead multidisciplinary teams across branding, web, UX/UI, content, digital marketing, and campaign development
  • Provide thoughtful creative direction and feedback that strengthens ideas and maintains brand integrity
  • Ensure work is strategically grounded, human-centered, and aligned with business outcomes
  • Mentor designers, writers, strategists, and other creative team members
  • Help foster a collaborative, accountable, and high-performing creative culture

Client Partnership

  • Serve as a trusted strategic advisor to executive stakeholders and marketing leaders
  • Present creative concepts, brand strategies, and campaign recommendations with confidence
  • Facilitate conversations that connect business goals with creative opportunities
  • Build alignment across client stakeholders and internal teams
  • Collaborate with account and project management teams to support successful delivery while protecting strategic and creative integrity

Research & Strategic Planning

  • Lead stakeholder interviews, audience research, competitive analysis, surveys, and workshop facilitation
  • Synthesize complex information into clear recommendations and executive-ready presentations
  • Apply design thinking and human-centered problem-solving to uncover meaningful insights
  • Monitor trends in branding, customer behavior, digital experiences, marketing, technology, and AI-enabled solutions
  • Contribute strategic and creative thinking to new business opportunities

Requirements

What We're Looking For

  • 5+ years of experience leading brand, digital, or integrated creative initiatives within an agency or consulting environment
  • Proven experience developing brand strategies, creative campaigns, digital experiences, and integrated marketing initiatives
  • Strong understanding of branding, UX/UI, web design, digital marketing, content strategy, and customer experience
  • Experience leading multidisciplinary teams across strategy, design, content, marketing, and technology
  • Exceptional storytelling, facilitation, presentation, and executive communication skills
  • Ability to translate complex business challenges into simple, compelling creative solutions
  • Experience presenting to executive leadership and facilitating strategic workshops
  • Strong understanding of modern digital ecosystems, including websites, CMS platforms, paid media, marketing automation, analytics, and emerging AI-enabled experiences
  • Collaborative leadership style grounded in curiosity, empathy, accountability, and continuous learning

Why This Role

  • Contract opportunity with a collaborative, design-driven agency
  • Lead strategic and creative work across diverse client engagements
  • Shape brand strategies, digital experiences, and integrated campaigns
  • Partner directly with executive stakeholders and marketing leaders
  • Mentor multidisciplinary creative teams and elevate creative standards
  • Contribute to new business growth and agency thought leadership
  • Balance creative excellence with measurable business impact

If you are a strategic creative leader who enjoys building brands, guiding teams, and shaping digital experiences that move organizations forward, we would love to connect.

raw.jobDescription:
Role Description: 

Defense Unicorns is seeking a Senior Full-Stack Engineer to join our Fleet team, focused on building and evolving Fleet Management and Edge Management capabilities within the UDS platform.

This role is centered on developing complex, data-driven interfaces that allow users to understand, manage, and operate distributed systems across edge and remote environments. These are not simple CRUD interfaces—they are operational control surfaces for real-world systems.

You will own and drive the frontend experience, while working across the stack to ensure tight alignment between UI behavior, APIs, and underlying system capabilities.

You’ll collaborate closely with backend engineers, platform engineers, and designers to build responsive, reliable, and intuitive experiences on top of complex APIs and distributed system state.

While frontend-focused, this role requires strong full-stack awareness—understanding how data flows through systems, how APIs are designed, and how frontend decisions impact system behavior, especially in asynchronous and distributed environments.

What You’ll Work On:

  • Building interfaces for managing individual assets and large fleets of systems
  • Designing and implementing data-rich UIs that reflect real-time and distributed system state
  • Developing workflows for deploying, updating, and monitoring systems across environments
  • Handling complex state management and asynchronous data flows
  • Integrating frontend applications with backend APIs and platform services
  • Improving usability and clarity for technically complex operations
  • Partnering with UX to translate complex system behavior into intuitive user experiences

Responsibilities: 

  • Design and build scalable, maintainable frontend applications
  • Collaborate with product, UX, and backend engineers to define and implement features
  • Translate complex backend capabilities into clear and usable interfaces
  • Write clean, testable, and well-structured code
  • Develop and maintain automated tests (unit, integration, and end-to-end)
  • Contribute to frontend architecture and technical decisions
  • Identify and improve performance, reliability, and usability issues
  • Work effectively in a remote, asynchronous environment

Travel Expectations/Requirements: 0-5%

The listed responsibilities are not exhaustive and additional responsibilities may be assigned based on the evolving needs of the organization. We are seeking a dynamic individual who is able to adapt and take on new responsibilities as they arise. 

Preferred Experience and Qualifications:

  • 5+ years of experience in frontend or fullstack development
  • Strong proficiency with modern frontend frameworks (Svelte or React preferred; Angular or similar frameworks acceptable)
  • Strong familiarity with modern frontend tooling and build system best practices
  • Experience with testing strategies across frontend applications
  • Experience building data-intensive or state-heavy applications
  • Strong understanding of API design and integration (REST, GraphQL, etc.)
  • Experience working closely with backend systems and distributed architectures
  • Strong problem-solving skills and ability to navigate complex systems
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills

Nice to Have:

  • Experience building interfaces for infrastructure, DevOps, or platform systems
  • Familiarity with Kubernetes, containers, or distributed systems concepts
  • Experience designing for constrained or unreliable network environments
  • Contributions to open source or developer tooling projects
  • Experience with CI/CD and deployment pipelines

Full compensation packages are based on candidate experience. Compensation ranges are established using national benchmarking data and apply across all geographic locations within the United States. 

Remote - USA$148,750—$201,250 USD

Who We Are

Defense Unicorns delivers mission value by streamlining software delivery so our customers can focus on the most important challenges. We share a vision of freedom and security for the advancement of progress and innovation. Our commitment to this vision, and to our mission-driven customers, means a commitment to speed, user experience and optionality, without compromising security. Our team is composed of innovators, software engineers, and veterans with decades of experience delivering technology programs across the federal market.

What We Do

We create and deliver secure solutions for continuous software integration and delivery. Defense Unicorns consolidates the best practices for security pipelines, testing, and deployment automation in order to meet the high security requirements valued by mission owners. Our solutions are agnostic by design and we believe that growing a robust ecosystem of secure, cloud-native software solutions can help enterprise customers inside and outside the federal market buy and integrate software more easily.

Who We Serve

Defense Unicorns’ customers are mission-focused leaders across public and private enterprises. We proudly support defense and civil agencies across the U.S. government and we work closely with the creators of leading-edge software solutions to deliver value to the mission-owner by improving the security and consumability of commercial software products.

What We Work On

  • Kubernetes
  • Cloud Environments (AWS/GCP and Azure)
  • Infrastructure-as-code (like Terraform/Pulumi)
  • Continuous Delivery and automation tooling
  • GitOps
  • Containers
  • CNCF projects and open source products and packages
  • Helm/Kustomize-Value Stream Mapping
  • Building and improving security delivery
  • Building Kubernetes and cloud native applications

Benefits Our Unicorns Enjoy

Health:

  • Medical/Dental/Vision
  • Premiums are 100% Company Paid
  • Health Savings Account
  • Life Insurance
  • Disability Insurance

Financial:

  • 401k Retirement Plan
  • Company Stock Options
  • Home Office Budget

Leave:

  • We offer all full-time Unicorns Flexible Time Off (FTO) plus all Federal Holidays, one week for Thanksgiving, and two weeks for Christmas and New Year’s
  • Paid Parental Leave

Learning:

  • Reimbursement for approved trainings/subscriptions
  • Conferences (travel, lodging, and fees)

Don’t have all the preferred experience or qualifications? Studies show that underrepresented groups like women and people of color are less likely to apply to jobs if they don't meet every requirement listed. 

At Defense Unicorns, we're committed to diversity. If you're enthusiastic about the role but don't match every criteria, we encourage you to apply. You could be the perfect fit for this or another role! Defense Unicorns is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, disability, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, national origin, veteran status, genetic information, union status and/or beliefs, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local law.

Venture Media is a full-service content marketing agency. We help businesses grow through social media, podcast production, SEO and AI visibility, and full-funnel content systems. We are a small, fast-moving remote team that ships real client work every week.


The role

We are looking for a Marketing Assistant to support content production and daily execution across our client accounts and internal brands. You will keep the content engine running: scheduling posts, prepping assets, and running research. Your job will be across assistant and marketing work, so you should like variety.


Marketing expertise is a plus for this role, but it is not required. What matters most is having a basic understanding of marketing and a genuine desire to learn and develop deeper expertise. We use automation and clear systems for the heavy lifting, so your job is less about busywork and more about keeping things organized, checking quality, and helping our content and clients look great. You will work directly with the founder and learn how a modern agency runs end to end.


What you will do

  • Content coordination and publishing. Schedule and publish blogs and posts, keep our content calendar organized, and make sure everything goes out on time. Much of the writing is already automated, so your role is organizing, reviewing, and adding the final human touch.
  • Quality control. Do a first pass on assets from our editors, proofread copy and decks before they go to clients, and make sure feedback actually gets addressed.
  • Research and reporting. Run market research for projects as needed, and help pull simple analytics reports so we know what is working.
  • Social and community support. Help manage engagement and distribution across our platforms, and keep our own brand active and consistent.
  • Light marketing execution. Learn the basics of SEO and AI search visibility, and help apply them to our content. We will teach you this piece by piece.
  • General right-hand work. Jump on whatever the day needs. Some days that is research, some days it is organizing a project in our task tools, some days it is prepping something for a client.


What we are looking for

  • Bachelor's in a related field or equivalent hands-on experience
  • 1 to 2 years in a marketing, social media, communications, or administrative role, ideally at an agency 
  • Extremely organized and proactive, able to juggle multiple priorities and stay detailed under deadline
  • Comfortable with the major social platforms (Meta, TikTok, LinkedIn, YouTube) and scheduling tools
  • Familiar with project management software
  • A reliable communicator who keeps managers updated and follows through without being chased
  • A flexible team player who adapts to shifting priorities and jumps in where needed
  • Clear written English and comfort in an async remote setup
  • Available during US Pacific business hours so we can work in real time
  • Dedicated to this as your main full-time focus, not a side gig


Nice to have (not required)

  • SEO or AI search visibility experience
  • Experience with task managers like ClickUp


Who this is not for

This is not a fit if you need constant hand-holding, avoid feedback, or prefer slow work with a lot of meetings. We move fast, hold clear standards, and expect you to own your tasks.


What you get

Description

DevOps Developer (AWS)

Fully Remote Opportunity

About BrightOrder

We build technology that keeps fleets safer, smarter, and more profitable.

Our platform connects maintenance, telematics, and data to help operators make real-time decisions.

We’re scaling fast across North America and we need exceptional builders who code, automate, and optimize systems end-to-end.

The Role

We’re looking for a Full Stack Developer with strong DevOps and AWS experience to help build, automate, and scale BrightOrder’s cloud-based platform.

This role is ideal for someone who can contribute across the stack — building backend services, APIs, integrations, internal tools, and frontend components — while also supporting cloud infrastructure, deployments, monitoring, and automation.

You’ll write production-grade code, improve developer workflows, and help keep our systems fast, secure, reliable, and scalable.

What You'll Do

  • Design, develop, and maintain full stack applications, backend services, APIs, and internal tools.
  • Write clean, maintainable code using Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, and Go (Golang).
  • Build and enhance frontend or internal tooling using React.js or similar frameworks.
  • Develop RESTful APIs, integrations, and service-to-service communication.
  • Build automation scripts and internal tools to improve deployments, monitoring, and troubleshooting.
  • Develop and maintain CI/CD pipelines for reliable releases.
  • Configure and manage AWS services, including ECS, EKS, Lambda, EC2, RDS, S3, and CloudWatch.
  • Optimize and maintain databases, including PostgreSQL and Amazon Aurora.
  • Use RabbitMQ or similar tools for inter-service communication.
  • Containerize and deploy applications using Docker and Kubernetes/EKS.
  • Use infrastructure as code tools such as Terraform or CloudFormation.
  • Build and maintain monitoring, logging, alerts, dashboards, and observability practices using tools such as New Relic, OpenTelemetry, CloudWatch, Prometheus, or Grafana to improve system reliability, performance visibility, and troubleshooting.
  • Collaborate with Product, QA, DevOps, and development teams to deliver secure, scalable releases.
  • Use tools such as Jira Service Management/Jira Service Desk to support issue tracking, escalation workflows, production support, and cross-functional communication with QA, Customer Support, and Development teams.
  • Support production troubleshooting, root cause analysis, and system reliability improvements.
  • Use AI tools such as Claude, ChatGPT, GitHub, Copilot, or similar platforms to support development, testing, documentation, and troubleshooting.


Requirements

Must-Have Experience

  • 5+ years of professional software development experience in a full stack, backend, DevOps, or cloud systems role.
  • Strong proficiency with Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, and React.js or another modern frontend framework.
  • Solid experience designing and building backend services, RESTful APIs, integrations, and service-based systems.
  • Intermediate hands-on experience with AWS services, including ECS/EKS, Lambda, RDS, EC2, S3, and CloudWatch.
  • Experience with CI/CD pipelines, deployment automation, Docker, Kubernetes, and Git-based workflows.
  • Strong database experience across relational and non-relational systems, including PostgreSQL, Microsoft SQL Server, Oracle, and MongoDB.
  • Familiarity with RabbitMQ, Redis, microservices, serverless architectures, GraphQL, real-time messaging, or similar distributed system technologies.
  • Experience with observability and monitoring tools such as New Relic, OpenTelemetry, CloudWatch, Prometheus, or Grafana.
  • Understanding of Linux systems, networking fundamentals, application security, cloud security best practices, security reviews, and vulnerability management.
  • Experience building tools or solutions for developers, operations, QA, customer support, or other internal users, including exposure to Jira Service Management/Jira Service Desk workflows.
  • Exposure to SaaS, fleet management, logistics, telematics, IoT, or connected device ecosystems.
  • Demonstrated use of AI-powered development tools for coding, documentation, testing, reviewing, and troubleshooting.

What Success Looks Like

Success in this role means you can contribute across the technical stack while improving the reliability, scalability, and efficiency of our cloud systems.

You write clean, secure, maintainable code, build practical solutions, automate repetitive work, improve internal workflows, and help the team ship better software faster.

Attributes We’re Looking For

We’re looking for someone who is accountable, resourceful, proactive, collaborative, reliable under pressure, tech savvy, results-oriented, service minded, fast-moving, and committed to continuous learning.

Our Values

At BrightOrder, how we work matters as much as what we build. We look for people who demonstrate Passion, Growth Mindset, Integrity, Authenticity, and Accountability.



Benefits

Why BrightOrder

  • Impact that matters — your work keeps fleets running and industries moving.
  • Fully remote, high-trust culture built on accountability and autonomy.
  • Competitive compensation with health, dental, and vision benefits.
  • Continuous learning through mentorship, new tech, and AI-driven innovation.
  • A team that values integrity, ownership, and excellence.

Ready to build?

Join BrightOrder and code the infrastructure that powers a safer, smarter logistics world.

description: Headquarters: Remote (Colorado, USA) URL: http://sailpoint.com About the Team Our CI/CD team sets clear delivery and release standards, providing the necessary tools, systems, and hands-on developer support to safely and securely release software assets for SailPoint's SaaS business and supporting functionality. About the Role At SailPoint, we are building the most comprehensive suite of identity governance & management SaaS products in the world. As the undisputed leader in identity governance and management for both human and non-human identities, SailPoint secures 46% of the Fortune 500 and 26% of the Forbes Global 2000. Built from the ground up on a microservices and a multi-tenant architecture, we enable customers to connect all of their relevant business applications and effectively manage and govern those identities and access controls. Furthermore, we believe that AI agents require the same rigorous security guardrails as humans—including least-privilege, access certifications, and separation of duties—and assert that AI security must be directly embedded within the core Enterprise Identity Governance and Administration ( IGA ) platform. As the CI/CD Engineering Manager, you will play a pivotal role in shaping the release velocity, security posture, and compliance standards of our engineering organization. We are seeking a passionate and experienced leader to direct a high-performing team of engineers dedicated to developer enablement, platform engineering, and pipeline security. You will lead the team that stewards the Secure SDLC and Internal Developer Platforms (IDPs)—empowering developers to ship code securely, meet stringent testing standards, and maintain a rigorous separation of duties. At scale, the solutions you will manage support a multi-geographic developer population of over 1,000 engineers and enable more than 250 deployments per week. Key Responsibilities Lead and Mentor: Build, lead, and develop a high-performing team of CI/CD, DevOps, and Platform engineers. Own people leadership responsibilities including monetary reimbursement, performance reviews, and setting clear performance expectations. Foster professional growth, career development, and technical excellence across the team. Secure SDLC & Software Supply Chain: Champion a culture of security and operational excellence. Set direction and hold the team accountable for maturing the platforms, pipelines, and guardrails that enable developers to deliver secure code. Ensure the team delivers and maintains automated supply chain security controls—including SCA / SAST scanning, Software Bill of Materials (SBOM) generation, artifact signing/provenance verification, and secrets detection—and that outcomes meet defined standards. AI Security for Internal Cloud Agents: Champion secure and safe release practices for our Internal Cloud Agent infrastructure. Ensure the team defines, implements, and maintains the controls and release patterns required to meet the same rigorous security standards applied across our software delivery ecosystem. Internal Developer Platform (IDP) Strategy: Partner with engineering and product to drive a joint vision for self-service developer portals and that reduce cognitive load for engineering squads. Prioritize and hold the team accountable for delivering secure, self-service capabilities—including repository provisioning and CI/CD templates—that meet developer and business needs. CI/CD and GitOps Delivery Architecture: Be accountable for the team's continuous integration and GitOps-driven continuous deployment capabilities. Ensure the team designs and operates robust pipelines and declarative deployment systems that deliver safe, incremental, and highly auditable software releases at scale. Compliance & Governance: Ensure the team implements and operates strict policy controls within the delivery space—including repository security, branch protections, push protections, and automated policy-as-code checks. Be accountable for separation of duties and compliance with frameworks such as FedRAMP and SOC 2. Pipeline Performance & FinOps: Establish performance and cost expectations for CI/CD infrastructure. Hold the team accountable for meeting pipeline runtime targets and FinOps objectives, and ensure CI/CD infrastructure is operated with production-tier discipline. Strategy & Roadmap: Partner with engineering leadership, product stakeholders, and security teams to define and prioritize the team's technical roadmap. Ensure alignment with business objectives and successful execution through the team. Qualifications Due to FedRAMP requirements, must be a US citizen residing in the US. Required Skills & Experience: Experience: 5+ years of experience as an Engineering Manager, DevOps/CI/CD Manager, or an equivalent technical leadership role within a cloud-native SaaS environment. Leadership: Proven ability to lead, mentor, recruit, and empower technical engineers, driving organizational change and fostering a collaborative, highly accountable team culture. CI/CD & GitOps Expertise: Demonstrated ability to lead teams operating modern CI/CD and GitOps environments. Sufficient technical depth to set delivery standards, evaluate architecture and tooling decisions and hold engineers accountable for safe, scalable, and auditable release practices. Software Supply Chain Security: Proven leadership ensuring secure software delivery in regulated or high-assurance environments. Ability to define and enforce supply chain security standards and hold teams accountable for compliance with those standards. Comfortable engaging security, compliance, and audit stakeholders on control design and evidence. Cloud Infrastructure & IaC: Working knowledge of cloud platforms and Infrastructure as Code sufficient to guide platform strategy, evaluate team designs, and be accountable for the reliability, security, and cost of CI/CD infrastructure. Performance & Metrics: Experience tracking pipeline health and delivery metrics (such as DORA metrics: deployment frequency, lead time for changes, MTTR , and change failure rate) to drive continuous improvement. Communication: Excellent interpersonal, negotiation, and communication skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively across highly distributed, cross-functional engineering teams. Programming: Solid foundational understanding of development with programming languages such as GoLang, Python, Java, or Javascript. Preferred Skills & Experience: Platform Engineering: Experience building, maintaining, and scaling self-service Developer Portals (e.g., Backstage) and Internal Developer Platforms (IDPs). Compliance Frameworks: Familiarity with audit and compliance standards for highly regulated environments (e.g., FedRAMP, SOC 2, ISO 27001). About the Team
 

Our CI/CD team sets clear delivery and release standards, providing the necessary tools, systems, and hands-on developer support to safely and securely release software assets for SailPoint's SaaS business and supporting functionality. By managing platforms that enable developers to deliver secure code in an incremental fashion while maintaining compliance, our team plays a critical role in fostering a seamless developer experience and helping SailPoint deliver high-quality, resilient services to our customers.
 

About the Role

At SailPoint, we are building the most comprehensive suite of identity governance & management SaaS products in the world. As the undisputed leader in identity governance and management for both human and non-human identities, SailPoint secures 46% of the Fortune 500 and 26% of the Forbes Global 2000. Built from the ground up on a microservices and a multi-tenant architecture, we enable customers to connect all of their relevant business applications and effectively manage and govern those identities and access controls. Furthermore, we believe that AI agents require the same rigorous security guardrails as humans—including least-privilege, access certifications, and separation of duties—and assert that AI security must be directly embedded within the core Enterprise Identity Governance and Administration (IGA) platform.
 

As the CI/CD Engineering Manager, you will play a pivotal role in shaping the release velocity, security posture, and compliance standards of our engineering organization. We are seeking a passionate and experienced leader to direct a high-performing team of engineers dedicated to developer enablement, platform engineering, and pipeline security. You will lead the team that stewards the Secure SDLC and Internal Developer Platforms (IDPs)—empowering developers to ship code securely, meet stringent testing standards, and maintain a rigorous separation of duties.
 

At scale, the solutions you will manage support a multi-geographic developer population of over 1,000 engineers and enable more than 250 deployments per week.
 

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead and Mentor: Build, lead, and develop a high-performing team of CI/CD, DevOps, and Platform engineers. Own people leadership responsibilities including monetary reimbursement, performance reviews, and setting clear performance expectations. Foster professional growth, career development, and technical excellence across the team.

  • Secure SDLC & Software Supply Chain: Champion a culture of security and operational excellence. Set direction and hold the team accountable for maturing the platforms, pipelines, and guardrails that enable developers to deliver secure code. Ensure the team delivers and maintains automated supply chain security controls—including SCA/SAST scanning, Software Bill of Materials (SBOM) generation, artifact signing/provenance verification, and secrets detection—and that outcomes meet defined standards.

  • AI Security for Internal Cloud Agents: Champion secure and safe release practices for our Internal Cloud Agent infrastructure. Ensure the team defines, implements, and maintains the controls and release patterns required to meet the same rigorous security standards applied across our software delivery ecosystem.

  • Internal Developer Platform (IDP) Strategy: Partner with engineering and product to drive a joint vision for self-service developer portals and that reduce cognitive load for engineering squads. Prioritize and hold the team accountable for delivering secure, self-service capabilities—including repository provisioning and CI/CD templates—that meet developer and business needs.

  • CI/CD and GitOps Delivery Architecture: Be accountable for the team's continuous integration and GitOps-driven continuous deployment capabilities. Ensure the team designs and operates robust pipelines and declarative deployment systems that deliver safe, incremental, and highly auditable software releases at scale.

  • Compliance & Governance: Ensure the team implements and operates strict policy controls within the delivery space—including repository security, branch protections, push protections, and automated policy-as-code checks. Be accountable for separation of duties and compliance with frameworks such as FedRAMP and SOC 2.

  • Pipeline Performance & FinOps: Establish performance and cost expectations for CI/CD infrastructure. Hold the team accountable for meeting pipeline runtime targets and FinOps objectives, and ensure CI/CD infrastructure is operated with production-tier discipline.

  • Strategy & Roadmap: Partner with engineering leadership, product stakeholders, and security teams to define and prioritize the team's technical roadmap. Ensure alignment with business objectives and successful execution through the team.
     

Qualifications

  • Due to FedRAMP requirements, must be a US citizen residing in the US.
     

Required Skills & Experience:

  • Experience: 5+ years of experience as an Engineering Manager, DevOps/CI/CD Manager, or an equivalent technical leadership role within a cloud-native SaaS environment.

  • Leadership: Proven ability to lead, mentor, recruit, and empower technical engineers, driving organizational change and fostering a collaborative, highly accountable team culture.

  • CI/CD & GitOps Expertise: Demonstrated ability to lead teams operating modern CI/CD and GitOps environments. Sufficient technical depth to set delivery standards, evaluate architecture and tooling decisions and hold engineers accountable for safe, scalable, and auditable release practices.

  • Software Supply Chain Security: Proven leadership ensuring secure software delivery in regulated or high-assurance environments. Ability to define and enforce supply chain security standards and hold teams accountable for compliance with those standards. Comfortable engaging security, compliance, and audit stakeholders on control design and evidence.

  • Cloud Infrastructure & IaC: Working knowledge of cloud platforms and Infrastructure as Code sufficient to guide platform strategy, evaluate team designs, and be accountable for the reliability, security, and cost of CI/CD infrastructure.

  • Performance & Metrics: Experience tracking pipeline health and delivery metrics (such as DORA metrics: deployment frequency, lead time for changes, MTTR, and change failure rate) to drive continuous improvement.

  • Communication: Excellent interpersonal, negotiation, and communication skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively across highly distributed, cross-functional engineering teams.

  • Programming: Solid foundational understanding of development with programming languages such as GoLang, Python, Java, or Javascript.
     

Preferred Skills & Experience:

  • Platform Engineering: Experience building, maintaining, and scaling self-service Developer Portals (e.g., Backstage) and Internal Developer Platforms (IDPs).

  • Compliance Frameworks: Familiarity with audit and compliance standards for highly regulated environments (e.g., FedRAMP, SOC 2, ISO 27001).

Bristol, Darlington, London, Manchester, Wolverhampton

Job Summary

We are MHCLG

Here at the Ministry of Housing, Communities & Local Government (MHCLG), we work on things that make a real difference to peopleâs lives. Whether it's through the homes we live in, the work of our local councils, or the communities weâre all part of, our work is at the top of the political agenda. We have ambitious and far-reaching outcomes to achieve, so thereâs never been a more exciting time to join us.

This Performance Analyst role will be part of our Elections Digital team at MHCLG. Itâs an exciting time to improve and expand our services to meet usersâ needs.

Our Services Include

  • Register to vote
  • Apply for a proxy vote
  • Apply for a postal vote
  • Apply for photo ID to vote (called a âVoter Authority Certificateâ)
  • And a product we have built for electoral teams in Local Authorities to support electoral administration.

We have lots to do. We must continue to improve our existing services to meet the needs of our users, especially those of disabled and other marginalised users. We must also think strategically about the future, understanding what problems still exist and champion user-centred ways of working to approach these issues.

You will be embedded in the Operations team, providing statistics and analysis for an existing portfolio of high-profile online services. Moreover, a substantial part of your responsibilities will be working with the Product and Design teams in Elections Digital, who are busy developing entirely new and exciting online services to improve voter registration as part of the Electoral Resilience & Democratic Engagement Programme.â¯â¯

This role will involve working closely with the development team on supporting user research and various analytics for services in various stages of development, and also performing analytics and continuous improvement to our existing services.â¯â¯

The role will also focus on supporting improvements to our digital compliance, making sure that we have proportionate data governance across the operational portfolio of live services that is aligned with MHCLG and data governance frameworks.

Find out more about our Digital teams and what they are working on through our MHCLG Digital blog. Please note that MHCLG do not offer visa sponsorship and applicants will need a valid visa for the duration of your employment.

â¯

Job Description

As a Performance Analyst, you'll:â¯â¯â¯

  • Be responsible for the performance analysis in your given area and help the product team measure and assess outcomes: for example, what good looks like and how it will be measured
  • Help to plan and ensure project delivery, finding opportunities to share information with the product team, community colleagues and others. Also to integrate the use of data analytics across the different phases of product of the product lifecycle
  • Be adaptable in applying analysis techniques to new contexts, especially when acting as the sole representative for performance analysts on a project
  • Be able to work on data governance artifacts with the wider team, including identifying documentary requirements, and then taking responsibility as a subject matter expert to deliver against these requirements
  • Be responsible for the accuracy and quality of data and analysis and how they are used, including putting robust quality assurance in place
  • Be engaged with, and actively contribute to, the performance analysis community

As a Performance Analyst, you'll:â¯â¯â¯

  • Help to plan and ensure project delivery, finding opportunities to share information with the product team, community colleagues and others. Also to integrate the use of data analytics across the different phases of product of the product lifecycle
  • Be adaptable in applying analysis techniques to new contexts, especially when acting as the sole representative for performance analysts on a project
  • Be able to work on data governance artifacts with the wider team, including identifying documentary requirements, and then taking responsibility as a subject matter expert to deliver against these requirements
  • Be responsible for the accuracy and quality of data and analysis and how they are used, including putting robust quality assurance in place
  • Be engaged with, and actively contribute to, the performance analysis community

Person specification

As a Performance Analyst, You'll Have

  • Knowledge on how to use the most appropriate medium to visualise data to tell compelling and actionable stories relevant for business goals. You can present, communicate and disseminate analysis and recommendations effectively, appropriately and with high impact
  • Knowledge on how to enable the team to develop a performance framework including KPIs or a service or product. You can provide the intelligence to support the formulation of both short-term and long-term strategic plans. You understand the different phases of product delivery and can plan and run the analysis for these. You can contribute to decision-making throughout the product life cycle
  • Skills to develop subject matter expertise in an area, and then apply this to support the development of comprehensive and robust governance frameworks. You can challenge incumbent ways of thinking, and will take full ownership of driving forward solutions to ensure compliance and clear transparent oversight
  • Ability to understand and identify who users are and what their needs are, based on evidence. You put users first and can manage competing priorities. You understand the importance of analysis to user-centred design and know how to collaborate with professions that are focused on user-centred design (for example, user research, user experience, content, design, business analysis)
  • Knowledge about quality assurance techniques including those used by other analytical professions, and be comfortable deploying these as relevant. You can identify the right data sources and then validate and understand how to interpret the results. You know how to ensure that data is fit for purpose

title: Human Resources Assistant
description: We are a growing organization committed to fostering a professional, inclusive, and employee-focused workplace. Our Human Resources team plays a critical role in supporting our workforce and ensuring that employees receive the resources, guidance, and support needed to succeed. We are currently seeking a highly organized and detail-oriented Human Resources Assistant to join our team and contribute to the smooth operation of our HR department. The Human Resources Assistant will provide comprehensive administrative and operational support across various HR functions, including recruitment, onboarding, employee relations, record management, compliance, and internal communications. This role is ideal for an individual who enjoys working with people, has strong organizational skills, and is passionate about supporting employee success while maintaining accurate and confidential HR records. As a key member of the HR team, you will assist with day-to-day human resources activities and help ensure that HR processes are carried out efficiently and in accordance with company policies and employment regulations. Â Key Responsibilities: Â Recruitment & Hiring Support Assist with the recruitment process by posting job advertisements, screening applications, and coordinating interviews. Schedule interviews and communicate with candidates throughout the hiring process. Prepare offer letters, employment contracts, and onboarding documentation. Maintain recruitment records and applicant tracking systems. Employee Onboarding & Administration Coordinate new employee onboarding and orientation activities. Prepare employee files and ensure all required documentation is completed and maintained. Assist employees with HR-related inquiries and requests. Maintain accurate employee records, databases, and filing systems. HR Operations & Compliance Ensure employee records remain current, accurate, and compliant with company policies and legal requirements. Assist in monitoring HR procedures and compliance standards. Support the preparation of HR reports, metrics, and documentation. Help administer employee policies, handbooks, and workplace procedures. Employee Engagement & Support Support employee engagement initiatives, training programs, and company events. Assist with performance review administration and employee development activities. Coordinate internal communications related to HR programs and announcements. Foster positive relationships with employees across all departments. General Administrative Duties Manage HR correspondence, calendars, and meeting schedules. Prepare reports, presentations, and HR-related documents. Organize and maintain confidential personnel records. Provide administrative support to the HR Manager and wider leadership team as required. Â Qualifications: High school diploma, Associate's or Bachelor's degree. Strong organizational and multitasking abilities. Excellent verbal and written communication skills. Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite, including Word, Excel, Outlook, and PowerPoint. Ability to maintain confidentiality and handle sensitive information with discretion. Strong attention to detail and accuracy. Professional, approachable, and team-oriented attitude. Â What We Offer: Competitive salary package. Professional development and career advancement opportunities. Supportive and collaborative work environment. Employee training and development programs. Comprehensive onboarding and ongoing support. Opportunity to make a meaningful contribution to employee success and organizational growth. Â If you are passionate about human resources, enjoy supporting people, and thrive in a fast-paced professional environment, we invite you to apply and become an important part of our HR team. title: Content Creator - Location-Based Video Tours (EU Only) - €50 onboarding
description: Tourizzy is a mobile travel platform that allows travelers to explore cities through short, location-based video tours accessed directly on location via a mobile app. You can download the app and try it yourself. We are looking for EU-based content creators to produce structured digital tours that combine storytelling, video, and local knowledge. What you will create: 1 intro video introducing you and the tour concept 10-15 short location-based videos per tour, each up to 90 seconds 1 written short tour brief outlining the route, locations, and narrative flow What we’re looking for: Creators based in the European Union Comfortable on camera with strong storytelling skills Ability to record quality video and audio on real locations (vertical video) Experience in travel, video content, or local storytelling is a plus What we offer: €50 onboarding bonus per completed and uploaded tour , paid regardless of downloads or in-app performance Revenue-sharing model for long-term earnings Up to 60/40 revenue split in favor of the creator for the first two years Opportunity to turn local knowledge into a scalable digital product This is a long-term collaboration , not a one-off freelance task. Apply via https://apply.tourizzy.com/ or feel free to share your details directly via email.
